verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that a trace is generated for each agent run, with spans for every model request and tool call (docs-14). Built-in, optional Logfire instrumentation sends detailed run information to that observability platform (docs-22, docs-31, docs-40), and the product supports OpenTelemetry tracing (docs-48). Logfire records model calls and tool calls in one trace (docs-50). A community user also reports pairing it with Langfuse (comm-3). Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the trace UI showing every LLM and tool span.
